notes.title: McPixel 3 is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]McPixel 3! Available now! Grab it while it's hot![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338580/McPixel_3/

After over 3 years of work I am honoured to present you with this amazing sequel! 100 levels of absolute goodness! Upgraded pixel graphics, minigames, an entire city to explore and more! If you ever wished there to be more McPixel, here it is! Check out the McPixel 3 store page for more!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4099044/055afe1a5e366bca08a33153a5504a5a24b39156.gif[/img]

notes.title: McPixel X-mas Free DLC has arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Holidays everyone![/h1]

To celebrate the upcoming observances, [b]McPixel[/b] has just received a fresh [b]pack of Holiday themed levels[/b]! Including a [b]Steam Sale themed level[/b]! 

Additionally, a user level pack titled [b]Userpack D[/b] has been assembled sporting [b]six community created McPixel levels[/b]! Make sure you [b]check out the level creator[/b] and maybe make a level as well! [b]It's fun![/b]

[b]Free DLC[/b] is free and available via the game's main menu! Just jump into the box labelled [b]Free DLC[/b] in the [b]Main Menu[/b] screen and enjoy [b]over 60 absolutely free additional McPixel levels[/b]!

And on top of that, [b]McPixel[/b] is currently on sale and you can [b]get it for only one dollar[/b]!

[b]Happy Holidays and everything else![/b]
Cheers!
[i]- Sos[/i]
